visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a split-screen format. In the lower half, a man with black hair, glasses, and a blue baseball cap is centered against a dark blue wall and a wooden headboard. He wears a white t-shirt with black text reading 'DARK CUISINE'. He looks directly at the camera with an energetic expression, gesturing with his hands. The top half is initially blank white. (2) The top half displays a game interface with a '1/5' progress marker and icons of a tiger, chickens, sheep, a human face, and a snake. The man points upwards, and green boxes highlight the icons in a rhythmic sequence as he speaks. (3) The top interface updates to '2/5', showing icons of baseball bats, a bundle of rope, kitchen knives, and a shovel. The man maintains a high energy level, bobbing his head and moving his hands in sync with the sequence highlights. (4) The progress marker reaches '3/5', and the icons switch to numbers including '20', '21', and several '1's ending with a '7'. The man's facial expression is joyful with a wide smile. (5) At '4/5', the icons change to human body parts: ears, an eye, an open mouth, a palm, feet, and a nose. The man continues to point and follow the rhythmic highlights. (6) The final phase '5/5' displays Chinese characters in six boxes arranged in a row. The man reads the text with a more focused and slightly dramatic facial expression, squinting his eyes towards the screen. (7) The man looks into the camera, leaning slightly forward with a playful smile as the background remains static before the clip ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks enthusiastically in Mandarin over a high-tempo, rhythmic electronic BGM. The track has a prominent synthesizer bass and a steady percussion beat. A soft 'ding' sound effect triggers as he transitions to the main challenge. (2) The speaker chants animal names rhythmically: 'Hu, Ji, Ji, Yang, Yang, Ji, Ren, She'. The delivery is staccato and synchronized with the heavy 4/4 electronic beat. Each chant syllable corresponds to a subtle percussive hit in the music. (3) The man chants object names: 'Bang, Bang, Sheng, Bang, Dao, Dao, Dao, Chan'. The pitch is consistent, and the volume is moderate and high-energy. The background music remains continuous with bright spectral brightness. (4) He chants a series of numbers rapidly: 'Er Ling Er Yi, Yi Yi Yi Yi Qi'. The speed of speech increases, maintaining perfect alignment with the fast BPM of the electronic track. (5) The chanting continues with body parts: 'Er, Er, Yan, Kou, Shou, Jiao, Jiao, Bi'. The tone is animated and comedic. Digital 'pop' sound effects occur subtly in the background during transitions. (6) The BGM continues until he reads a full sentence: 'Wo Zhi Dao Ni Zuo Le Shen Me'. Immediately after the last word, the music stops abruptly and is replaced by a loud, percussive thud sound effect, creating a sudden moment of silence and dramatic impact.
